description: An absolute same-host stylesheet redirects (302) to a URL that answers 404: critical silently drops it.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on the page's own host fails the whole job (decision: shipping critical css that silently lacks the owner's own rules is worse than shipping none). (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
